_comment: PLACEHOLDER escape routes so the margin engine can run before Person A writes data/yarnell/routes.geojson. Both start at the real observation deck (sites.geojson). R1 passes the real deployment site; both safety zones are MADE UP (not Boulder Springs Ranch, not the real black). Each LineString runs FROM the crew start TO a safety zone. Tuned so the simulator's wind shift (270 -> 180) with a fire at placeholder N2 turns R1 red and reroutes to R2.
